### Uniform Hazard Spectra (UHS)

```{r}
p.target <- c("mean", 0.84, 0.90, 0.95)
.ID.BASE <- .currentTarget("ID.target")
ID.target <- .resolveUhsIDTarget(
  UHSTable,
  "UHS slide",
  target = .ID.BASE,
  siteID = .currentTarget("siteID.target")
)
.ID.BASE <- .targetBaseID(ID.target, "UHS slide")
```

{{< include /_fig/UHS.qmd >}}

### PGA
